verification.notes: Contratos conferidos no portal BR autenticado em 2026-10-01: produto v2, loja v2, campanhas v2, feeds FULL/DELTA, conversionReport e validatedReport. Tipos literais preservados; limite de relatórios 500 e cursor de uso único/30s documentados. Janela 90 dias é política local. BRL inferido do mercado. Nenhuma nova operação foi executada com credenciais reais pelo agente.

search.query: query SearchOffers { productOfferV2(keyword:{{keyword}},page:{{page}},limit:{{limit}},sortType:{{sort_type}},shopId:{{shop_id}},productCatId:{{category_id}},isAMSOffer:{{is_ams_offer}},isKeySeller:{{is_key_seller}}) { nodes { itemId shopId productName shopName productLink priceMin priceMax commissionRate commission sales ratingStar periodStartTime periodEndTime imageUrl productCatIds priceDiscountRate shopType sellerCommissionRate shopeeCommissionRate } pageInfo { page limit hasNextPage } } }

get.query: query GetOffer { productOfferV2(itemId:{{item_id}},shopId:{{shop_id}}) { nodes { itemId shopId productName shopName productLink priceMin priceMax commissionRate commission sales ratingStar periodStartTime periodEndTime imageUrl productCatIds priceDiscountRate shopType sellerCommissionRate shopeeCommissionRate } } }

shops.query: query SearchShopOffers { shopOfferV2(keyword:{{keyword}},page:{{page}},limit:{{limit}},sortType:{{sort_type}},shopId:{{shop_id}},shopType:{{shop_types}},isKeySeller:{{is_key_seller}}) { nodes { commissionRate imageUrl offerLink originalLink shopId shopName ratingStar shopType remainingBudget periodStartTime periodEndTime } pageInfo { page limit hasNextPage } } }

campaigns.query: query SearchCampaignOffers { shopeeOfferV2(keyword:{{keyword}},page:{{page}},limit:{{limit}},sortType:{{sort_type}}) { nodes { commissionRate imageUrl offerLink offerName offerType categoryId collectionId periodStartTime periodEndTime } pageInfo { page limit hasNextPage } } }

feeds.query: query ListProductFeeds { listItemFeeds(feedMode:{{feed_mode}}) { feeds { datafeedId datafeedName referenceId description totalCount date feedMode } } }

feed.query: query GetProductFeed { getItemFeedData(datafeedId:{{datafeed_id}},offset:{{offset}},limit:{{limit}}) { rows { columns updateType } pageInfo { offset limit totalCount hasMore } } }

conversion.query: query GetConversionReport { conversionReport(purchaseTimeStart:{{purchase_time_start}},purchaseTimeEnd:{{purchase_time_end}},limit:{{limit}},scrollId:{{cursor}},shopId:{{shop_id}},productId:{{product_id}},orderId:{{order_id}},orderStatus:{{order_status}}) { nodes { conversionId purchaseTime clickTime shopeeCommissionCapped sellerCommission totalCommission netCommission mcnManagementFee utmContent campaignType device orders { orderId orderStatus items { shopId shopName itemId itemName actualAmount qty itemTotalCommission itemSellerCommission itemShopeeCommissionCapped displayItemStatus fraudStatus campaignType } } } pageInfo { limit hasNextPage scrollId } } }

validated.query: query GetValidatedReport { validatedReport(validationId:{{validation_id}},limit:{{limit}},scrollId:{{cursor}}) { nodes { conversionId purchaseTime clickTime shopeeCommissionCapped sellerCommission totalCommission netCommission mcnManagementFee utmContent campaignType device orders { orderId orderStatus items { shopId shopName itemId itemName actualAmount qty itemTotalCommission itemSellerCommission itemShopeeCommissionCapped displayItemStatus fraudStatus campaignType } } } pageInfo { limit hasNextPage scrollId } } }
